en: Sepia-toned vintage street view of a European town. It shows a wide unpaved road lined with multi‑storey residential and commercial buildings on both sides. On the left is a row of houses with a shop sign on the nearer corner building. On the right are larger houses, one with a distinctive corner tower and steep roof. A person with a pram is visible in the distance. Printed captions at the top identify the town and the street.
